name: agent-reproducibility-profile
research_question: How far does the accuracy of the retrieval agent move under controlled perturbations of the software environment, the accelerator, the benchmark version, the model version, the implementation, and the temperature - relative to how far it moves when only the random seed changes?
hypothesis: Seed variance dominates the environment and hardware axes, but the dataset version and the model version move the result by more than one seed standard deviation, which means a reproduction that differs on those axes should not be expected to match.
headline: full-agent scored 0.7478 +/- 0.0214 on accuracy over 10 seeds, beating every baseline; the narrowest margin is +0.2200 over rag-classic [0.2032, 0.2368] (paired-t, adjusted p=0.0000).

claims.statement: full-agent scored 0.7478 against rag-classic's 0.5277 on accuracy (10 replications each, +0.2200 [0.2032, 0.2368] at 95% confidence). The difference is statistically detectable (paired-t, adjusted p=0.0000) with a large effect size (Hedges' g=8.59).

implementation (full-agent-reordered): moved accuracy by +0.0027 [-0.0071, 0.0126], 0.1x the seed noise; stability 1.00 [0.91, 1.00] (not distinguishable from relabelling noise, permutation p=0.716), and whether it stays within the declared tolerance of 0.01 is undecided: the interval straddles that boundary.

environment (hash-randomised): moved accuracy by +0.0000 [0.0000, 0.0000], 0.0x the seed noise; stability 1.00 [1.00, 1.00] (not distinguishable from relabelling noise, permutation p=1.000), within the declared tolerance of 0.01.

environment (single-threaded): moved accuracy by +0.0000 [0.0000, 0.0000], 0.0x the seed noise; stability 1.00 [1.00, 1.00] (not distinguishable from relabelling noise, permutation p=1.000), within the declared tolerance of 0.01.

hardware (no-accelerator): moved accuracy by +0.0000 [0.0000, 0.0000], 0.0x the seed noise; stability 1.00 [1.00, 1.00] (not distinguishable from relabelling noise, permutation p=1.000), within the declared tolerance of 0.01.
configuration (temperature-0.8): moved accuracy by -0.0632 [-0.0754, -0.0511], 3.0x the seed noise; stability 0.05 [0.01, 0.09], beyond the declared tolerance of 0.01.
dataset (agent-benchmark@v2): moved accuracy by +0.0302 [0.0223, 0.0382], 1.4x the seed noise; stability 0.38 [0.24, 0.52], beyond the declared tolerance of 0.01.
model (sim-reasoner@v2): moved accuracy by +0.0252 [0.0194, 0.0311], 1.2x the seed noise; stability 0.48 [0.33, 0.64], beyond the declared tolerance of 0.01.

Deterministic: 4 executions of an identical run produced identical values on every result metric (accuracy, robustness). latency_ms varied, as expected: those measure the machine rather than the method.

limitations: With 10 replications and the observed spread, this design could detect a difference of 0.0233 in accuracy or larger 80% of the time at alpha=0.05.
Changing the configuration moves accuracy by -0.0632, beyond the declared tolerance of 0.01. Results should not be expected to reproduce across configuration changes.
Changing the dataset moves accuracy by +0.0302, beyond the declared tolerance of 0.01. Results should not be expected to reproduce across dataset changes.
Changing the model moves accuracy by +0.0252, beyond the declared tolerance of 0.01. Results should not be expected to reproduce across model changes.
Whether a change of implementation keeps accuracy within its declared tolerance of 0.01 is undecided: the interval [-0.0071, 0.0126] straddles that boundary. More runs on that axis would resolve it.

accuracy.rationale: Holm-Bonferroni controls the family-wise error rate with uniformly more power than Bonferroni and no extra assumptions.

reproducibility.method: stability(axis) = 1 - max(0, (|Cliff's delta| - E|delta|_null) / (1 - E|delta|_null)), where E|delta|_null is the mean |Cliff's delta| under random relabelling of the same samples. The seed axis is the reference noise floor and is not scored.

seed.description: seed: 10 seeds of 'full-agent' give accuracy = 0.7478 +/- 0.0214 (CV 2.87%), mean [0.7324, 0.7631]. A replication using 5 of these seeds would reach the same conclusion 0% of the time, but that is a limit of the test rather than of the effect: with 5 runs the smallest attainable p-value is 0.0625, which is above alpha, so no 5-seed replication could reach significance whatever it measured.
seed.role: reference noise floor; not scored as a perturbation

reproducibility.description: Across 7 perturbation axes, the most fragile is 'configuration' (stability 0.05); the geometric mean is 0.51. Changing configuration, dataset, model moves accuracy beyond the tolerance declared for it, so a reproduction differing on those axes should not be expected to match. On implementation the data cannot decide whether the shift stays within tolerance; more runs would be needed to say.
notes: Axes from most to least fragile: configuration (0.05), dataset (0.38), model (0.48), implementation (1.00), environment (1.00), environment (1.00), hardware (1.00)

These axes move the result further than one seed standard deviation: configuration (3.0x), dataset (1.4x), model (1.2x). A paper reporting seed variance alone would understate its own uncertainty on them.
